title: LIV高尔夫从搅局者到困境资产
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Over night, the most polite sport in the world tore itself apart.
segments.zh: 一夜之间，世界上最绅士的运动发生了内讧。

segments.en: The new live golf series launched with a tournament in London.
segments.zh: 新的高尔夫直播系列赛在伦敦开赛。

segments.en: Four years ago, some of the PGA's top players defected to live golf, seeking a sweeter payout.
segments.zh: 四年前，一些顶级球员转投直播高尔夫，寻求更高回报。

segments.en: It was a business decision, first and foremost.
segments.zh: 这首先是一个商业决策。

segments.en: The Michelson reportedly signed a deal with $200 million.
segments.zh: 据报道，米克尔森签下了2亿美元的合同。

segments.en: The breakaway league truly fractured professional golf.
segments.zh: 这个分离联盟真正分裂了职业高尔夫。

segments.en: I disagree with it. They turned their back on what has allowed them to get to this position.
segments.zh: 我不同意。他们背弃了让他们走到今天的一切。

segments.en: Live golf's business model was predicated on the whims of one nation, Saudi Arabia.
segments.zh: 直播高尔夫的业务模式依赖于一个国家的意愿——沙特阿拉伯。

segments.en: In less than five years, the Saudi spent over $5 billion on live golf.
segments.zh: 不到五年，沙特在直播高尔夫上花费超过50亿美元。

segments.en: It was meant to be the ultimate soft power flicks, but times have changed.
segments.zh: 这原本是终极的软实力展示，但时代已经变了。

segments.en: It's very expensive to run this league, and then you have a war happening in the Middle East.
segments.zh: 运营这个联赛成本高昂，而且中东还在打仗。

segments.en: Saudi's public investment fund announced it will be pulling its funding at the end of the season.
segments.zh: 沙特公共**基金宣布将在赛季末撤资。

segments.en: That's left-lived, looking for someone else to help put the bill.
segments.zh: 这让他们不得不寻找其他资金来源。

segments.en: We're very fortunate at a lead investor signed a term she approved by our boy.
segments.zh: 幸运的是，一位主要市场参与者签署了条款。

segments.en: So how did this glamorous sign of the country club seen suddenly find itself in the bunker?
segments.zh: 那么，这个光鲜的乡村俱乐部为何突然陷入困境？
